spec.pose: Evelynn from Reference 2 is preparing BEFORE putting on the gala dress. Dress her in a soft ivory cotton bathrobe, long sleeves, opaque fabric, fully wrapped closed across chest and tied securely at waist, knee-to-mid-calf length. She stands naturally beside the garment rail, face in readable three-quarter view, gently touching the hanger of the single black gala gown which remains on the rail. She is NOT wearing an evening dress. Preserve her face, brunette updo, adult proportions, the warm dressing room from Reference 1, confident ink lines and semi-cel shadows. Quiet practical preparation, relaxed posture, no glamour pose. Keep head and robe hem inside frame.
